title: Individual AI productivity is outpacing enterprise profit
evidence: Eighty percent report individual productivity gains from AI, while 37% report positive enterprise EBIT impact and 6% qualify as high performers.

title: Logistics AI strategy is not reaching the P&L
evidence: Among 30 major logistics operators, 97% call AI strategic and 67% have dedicated budgets, but 13% report measurable financial impact.

title: Finance teams adopt AI faster than they measure it
evidence: Seventy-seven percent of finance organisations use AI, but 35% measure ROI effectively and only 14% employ it under a defined strategy.

title: Salesforce reports commercial traction for enterprise AI
evidence: Salesforce reported AI and data ARR near $3.9 billion, up over 210%; premium Sales and Service AI SKU bookings more than doubled quarter-on-quarter.

title: Entry-level hiring carries the first visible labour pressure
evidence: Employment for 22–25-year-olds in AI-exposed roles is 19% below the level implied by growth in less-exposed occupations, mainly through reduced hiring; researchers call the evidence descriptive, not causal.

title: AI infrastructure is accumulating physical-world risk
evidence: Annual data-centre investment may exceed $1 trillion by 2027, while 79% of global capacity sits in areas with elevated natural-catastrophe risk.
